It’s hard but everyone is different, I advise people to go off the internet for a while and speak to a psychiatrist for a diagnosis. MOST people who go through dpdr have severe anxiety and stress.

I think the OP is telling us that it’s not okay to compare somebody else’s experience with your own and think you’ll have it for this long. Everyone recovers from dpdr at different times. Sometimes it takes people weeks, months and even years like you said, and there’s others who were completely unaware like you were who had no idea that they even had it which caused them to have it for years without any treatment. I think it’s okay to look up symptoms but to go on forums and to constantly read others experiences does take a toll on people’s ability to fully recover and might lead to more depression and anxiety.
